# Shortcut: update

<!-- GENERATED by generate-profile/scripts/build-shortcut-skills.py from .aid/runtime/templates/shortcut-catalog.yml -- DO NOT EDIT BY HAND; edit the catalog row and re-run the helper, then the full run_generator.py. -->

Bind **VERB=`update`**, **ARTIFACT="" (bare verb)**, then run the shared engine at `.aid/runtime/templates/shortcut-engine.md`. The engine scaffolds the flattened Lite work (feature-001 structure) and authors exactly two documents: `REQUIREMENTS.md`, whose `§ 11` feature section carries the technical specification and whose `§ 9` carries the gate criteria, and the task `DETAIL.md` files -- with reduced capture. One feature and one delivery means there is nothing to sequence, so no plan is written and the execution graph is derived from each task's `**Depends on:**` field. It runs the per-document Grading Gates (feature-004) and halts at the FR-10 approval gate. It never executes. This shortcut's `default_type`/`group` are its row in `.aid/runtime/templates/shortcut-catalog.yml`.

**Kinds.** When the argument starts with one of these kinds, take that word off the description, bind **ARTIFACT** to it and use the catalog row `aid-update-<kind>` as `{name}`: `api`, `ui`, `theme`, `cli`, `data-model`, `data-pipeline`, `messaging`, `integration`, `job`, `config`, `infra`, `test`, `dashboard`.

When it starts with one of these, do not run the engine: read `references/<kind>.md` in this skill's folder and follow it with the rest of the argument: `roadmap`, `mvp`, `backlog`, `architecture`, `stack`, `testing-strategy`, `cicd`, `document`.
